svg.aria-label: Product engineering with Claude Code, signed Sylent. The process: a project starts from the template; changes are picked from the backlog into the roadmap, sized and split into sub-steps if needed, and go through the tools they need (specifications, structure, wireframes, mock-up, tokens, build) to a pull request; an urgent fix goes straight to a pull request, an exploration, at any time, tries a question of a step or an idea of the backlog and gives its result back; a cycle ends with the launch and the retrospective, whose leftovers return to the backlog.
svg.text: FROM AN IDEA TO A SITE ONLINE, THEN EVERY CHANGE
